assets.notes: The input, amount, disposition and retained-row table read in that order. Coral is reserved for the review decision; teal and green identify preserved facts.
The correction-to-resolution path is the dominant reading order. Four compact guardrail panels keep the safety conditions visible without competing with the result.

limitations: The cards prove deterministic synthetic behavior only; they do not prove a live Google Sheets write, relay delivery or production scheduler state.

Local repeat renders produced identical PNG hashes. A different operating system or font stack may rasterize the committed SVG source differently, so the committed PNG hashes remain the immutable media reference.
